infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: AcoustiTape requires access to your microphone to capture room impulse responses (such as a handclap) for calculating reverberation time (RT60).
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: AcoustiTape uses your location to geo-tag room acoustic measurements for architectural campus audits.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: AcoustiTape uses the camera to capture room photos to document wall surfaces and acoustic treatments.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: AcoustiTape accesses photos to attach room images to acoustic measurement reports.
